chapters.title: Google Drive notebook and recording copies (Android beta)
chapters.coverage: Android beta16/build69 includes immediate local practice start without waiting for Drive or disabling synchronization. Starting/active practice defers incoming adoption. Conflict review lists retained independent practices and overlapping values; both choices retain independent records, fields and annotation marks. Technical catalogue reports no longer create/invalidate reviewed decisions. The incremental format, stable IDs, JSON export/recovery and additive recording copies remain available, including free takes without a piece. Final synthetic graph/browser tests and Android emulator checks pass; physical Google/two-device acceptance remains open. Original emulator logical baseline is empty after the earlier beta13 incident; current review uses isolated synthetic notebooks. Source-only D-059 adds a device-local mobile-data switch for recording copies, independent of score downloads and shared notebook transport. Browser metered-cellular upload/download, policy propagation and reload persistence pass in profile/2026-10-17-media-mobile-data-01; published beta16 is unchanged. Packaged in Android beta17/build70 with final browser evidence at profile/2026-10-17-beta17-media-mobile-data-01 and release validation/publication manifests. Physical cellular/Google acceptance remains open.

visualAcceptance.scope: Presented Today layout and implemented D-002–D-004 scope; child flows and remaining behavior/accessibility/native coverage stay open.

chapters.title: Your practice session
chapters.coverage: Current beta12 adds verified recording copies through the connected notebook Google account and removes the isolated transfer test. Local playback/capture, JSON exclusion, identity and retention remain verified. See the current Drive notebook/copies chapter; older media-disabled statements below describe earlier releases. Overview, live editing and confirmed feedback/lifecycle repairs; full exercise, score and feedback child reviews remain open. D-008 warm-up sets, repertoire piece choice, parts and MusicXML follow verified by tests on 2026-10-03. D-010 generated-practice toolbar and D-011 directional block navigation were verified in four responsive layouts on 2026-10-04. D-012's consolidated menu is superseded by the implemented D-013 flat shortcuts; the new responsive/browser verification and native/accessibility gates remain open. D-015 replaces the Hanon SVG/3D motion with four soft snapshots; build, focused unit checks and live responsive-browser review pass, while owner acceptance, dated four-layout evidence and native coverage remain open. Beta 2 timing, PDF edit/resume, practiced-duration editing and MIDI gestures verified in responsive browser checks on 2026-10-12; Android/iOS native screen-awake bridge activation/release checked separately. D-037 raised PDF/MusicXML score timer verified in responsive browser timing and phone/tablet geometry on 2026-10-14; native/package acceptance and reported two-second freeze remain open. D-038 direct score entry, always-visible Edit/Finish and resume on editing Back verified in responsive browsers on 2026-10-14; original Android PDF freeze and native/package acceptance remain open. Published beta 5/build44 contains D-037/D-038; Android replacement installation/version/foreground and public artifact hashes verified on 2026-10-14. Native PDF timing acceptance remains separate. D-042 beta 6.1 Progress time chart, type/piece filters and six ranges verified in responsive browsers on 2026-10-15 (progress/2026-10-15-time-chart); source only, with owner/native visual acceptance open. Beta 6.1 local repertoire audio/video capture, Multimedia library, actual-file/installation filtering, playback, save retry and notebook-replacement retention are browser-verified with synthetic streams (multimedia/2026-10-15-local-03). Missing WebM playback duration is finalized for new and legacy previews in source; a synthetic two-minute timeline, five-second position, seek/resume/reopen and stored-take retention are browser-verified in four layouts (multimedia/2026-10-15-playback-duration-02). The duration correction and saved-viewer refinements are now packaged in website Android beta7/build60; native physical playback/visual acceptance remains open. Website beta7/build60 adds a separate Android Profile Drive transfer check for a synthetic tone, with native staging and notebook retention verified; real Google consent and remote two-device acceptance remain open. Personal media auto-sync/migration are disabled. Saved viewers now offer red-link Delete and Close, with pencil/check title editing that preserves playback, retry text and identity; draft Save/Discard is retained. Verified in 16 light/dark responsive frames (multimedia/2026-10-15-viewer-title-01); source-only, native/owner acceptance open. Native camera/microphone and owner layout acceptance remain pending; binaries are excluded from notebook backup/sync. Floating Record/Stop, pause without editing and in-place pencil/check controls are covered by multimedia/2026-10-15-floating-stop-05 responsive evidence; native acceptance remains open. D-043 horizontal stand selection, Other pieces repertoire/catalogue routing and PDF permission-visibility recovery are browser-verified on 2026-10-15 (preparation/2026-10-15-stand-other-pieces-04); native/physical scope is recorded separately in the active preparation review. A same-version local Android review APK verifies repertoire-session audio/video capture, review and final Save with emulator streams and already-granted permissions (multimedia/2026-10-15-native-permissions-07); native PDF rendering on emulator WebView 113 and physical capture acceptance remain open. D-043 is included in website Android 6.1.0-beta.2/build55, published on 2026-10-15; final package/installation, 17 IndexedDB file hashes, foreground and public download hashes are verified. Physical PDF recording/visual acceptance remains open. D-044 hours/minutes in Progress is implemented and verified in 55 responsive frames with saved-time/goal/chart labels and notebook retention (progress/2026-10-15-hours-minutes-01). Published in website Android 6.1.0-beta.3/build56 on 2026-10-15; package/signature, replacement install, 18 retained IndexedDB hashes, foreground and public downloads verified. Native visual acceptance remains open. D-045 double-tap minimize/restore and reduced toolbar height are implemented, verified in 46 responsive-browser frames with touch/keyboard and existing PDF/MusicXML checks (session/2026-10-15-minimized-toolbar-07). Published in website Android 6.1.0-beta.4/build57 on 2026-10-15; final package/signature, replacement installation, retained notebook files, foreground and public downloads verified. Native/owner visual acceptance remains open. D-046 light-theme black-key correction is browser-verified in 24 material states with nine keyboard/practice checks; 35 website captures refreshed. Published as website Android 6.1.0-beta.5/build58 on 2026-10-15; package, signature, replacement install, notebook retention, foreground and public pages/downloads/images verified. Native visual acceptance remains open.

chapters.title: Profile and the beta introduction
chapters.coverage: Themes and walkthrough verified in responsive browser; warm-up initial focus and scroll verified on iPhone simulator. Physical MIDI and notification delivery acceptance are tracked separately. Light-appearance source follow-up verified across 52 responsive states on 2026-10-14; D-039 layered navigation appearance verified in both themes/four responsive layouts on 2026-10-15; published in Android beta 10/build49 with replacement installation, data retention, foreground and public hashes verified. Physical/native visual acceptance remains separate; iOS remains beta 9/build48. Current-source primary-header parity verified on 2026-10-15 across 384 responsive route/language/theme/size states, with sticky Library tabs below the 68 px bar and long-title containment; included in signed Android 6.0.0/build53; native installation and foreground verified, with populated native/physical visual acceptance separate.

chapters.title: Back up and synchronize your notebook
chapters.coverage: QR/manual linking and compatible/organized backup behavior verified in responsive browser/synthetic tests. Native camera and cloud-provider acceptance pending. Persistent local continuation, pending-provider escape, practice/save/restart and same-notebook repair verified with synthetic browser providers on 2026-10-15; Android replacement install retains all notebook file hashes. Real Drive/provider and physical-device acceptance remain open. D-047/D-048 in beta6/build59 accept Catalan reader settings, keep setup errors visible, separate joining from QR sharing in Manage and require disconnect before replacing a connected/paused notebook. Ninety focused checks and 20 synthetic responsive frames pass; real Android picker launch/cancel is separately verified. Published as website Android beta6/build59 on 2026-10-15; public pages, checksum manifest, downloads and retained website images match. Physical Drive acceptance remains open.

chapters.title: Plan your practice
chapters.coverage: Android beta 12/build51 contains D-040/D-041 circular session rows, hidden horizontal scrolling, fixed Week Add, subtle day dividers, compact month/year wording and a one-line Calendar selector. Responsive checks cover both themes, four orientations, 320px, three languages and durations through 720 min. Emulator replacement installation/data retention/foreground and package hashes pass; physical/native visual acceptance remains separate. iOS remains beta 9/build48.

chapters.title: Practice rhythm and recordings
chapters.coverage: Android beta16/build69 includes musical streak/calendar/history behavior and compact uncounted audio/video icons, toggleable type filters and a visible piece filter. Home and Multimedia offer standalone free or repertoire recording with horizontal stand-only cards and Other pieces search. Audio measures actual input; video starts at preview with camera selection, start/pause/resume/finish, encoded portrait/landscape output and a framed title/date caption. Selecting the suggested title clears it for typing. Existing recording/session/work IDs, notebook, PDFs and annotations are retained. Final 100-frame browser evidence uses synthetic streams; separate Android emulator camera/rotation checks pass. Physical-device and owner visual acceptance remain open. Source-only 2026-10-17 caption follow-up raises the encoded frame with a 10% bottom inset, verified from decoded portrait/landscape pixels in multimedia/2026-10-17-caption-bottom-padding-01. The owner requests no APK recreation; the published beta16 package remains unchanged. Raised video caption clearance is packaged in Android beta17/build70; final browser evidence is multimedia/2026-10-17-beta17-recording-01. Earlier source-only statements record the prior stage.
